sources.title: RFC 2784: Generic Routing Encapsulation (GRE)
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: L2TPv3：Session ID、Cookie 與負載邊界
related.titleEn: L2TPv3: Session ID, cookie and payload boundary
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受1476/1472 B且表頭旗標吻合；未涵蓋其他GRE擴充。 交接時須能核對：交付 gre-layout.csv、C旗標解析與MTU回歸樣本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept1476/1472 B with matching flags; other GRE extensions are outside this fixture. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver gre-layout.csv, C-flag parser checks and MTU regression samples.
related.difference: 建立每個Session ID的cookie長度與值表，再尋找內Ethernet起點。
related.differenceEn: Build session-specific cookie length/value records before locating the inner Ethernet frame.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
GRE基本表頭與可選checksum區消耗外層IP預算；內外TTL仍屬不同封包層。
教學基準：1500-20-4 = 1476 B；對照：1500-20-4-4 = 1472 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

L2TPv3資料封裝需按會談協商解析cookie長度；不能把cookie當封包序號。
教學基準：1500-20-4-8-14 = 1454 B；對照：1500-20-4-4-14 = 1458 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
GRE base and optional checksum fields consume outer-IP budget; inner and outer TTL belong to different layers.
Teaching baseline: 1500-20-4 = 1476 B; comparison: 1500-20-4-4 = 1472 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

L2TPv3 data parsing follows negotiated cookie length; a cookie is not a packet sequence number.
Teaching baseline: 1500-20-4-8-14 = 1454 B; comparison: 1500-20-4-4-14 = 1458 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Segment Routing：SID 清單與路徑約束
related.titleEn: Segment Routing: SID lists and path constraints
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受1476/1472 B且表頭旗標吻合；未涵蓋其他GRE擴充。 交接時須能核對：交付 gre-layout.csv、C旗標解析與MTU回歸樣本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept1476/1472 B with matching flags; other GRE extensions are outside this fixture. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver gre-layout.csv, C-flag parser checks and MTU regression samples.
related.difference: 在小型圖上逐段展開node SID最短路徑與adjacency SID固定邊，保存結果。
related.differenceEn: Expand node-SID shortest paths and adjacency-SID fixed edges on a small graph.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
GRE基本表頭與可選checksum區消耗外層IP預算；內外TTL仍屬不同封包層。
教學基準：1500-20-4 = 1476 B；對照：1500-20-4-4 = 1472 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

Segment Routing以有序segments表達轉送指示；節點SID與鄰接SID約束不同。
教學基準：4*4 = 16 B；對照：6*4 = 24 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
GRE base and optional checksum fields consume outer-IP budget; inner and outer TTL belong to different layers.
Teaching baseline: 1500-20-4 = 1476 B; comparison: 1500-20-4-4 = 1472 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

Segment Routing expresses forwarding through ordered segments; node SIDs and adjacency SIDs impose different constraints.
Teaching baseline: 4*4 = 16 B; comparison: 6*4 = 24 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
